supporting_observations.claim: Seven connection records from WS-LMARTINS-01 show connections to PROXY-NWD-01 on port 8080 between 13:35:56 and 14:05:48 UTC. The intervals are approximately 4 minutes 19 seconds to 5 minutes 29 seconds.

The observed cadence is consistent with the inventory description of PixelForge Suite checking for updates about every five minutes, but these connection records do not establish that PixelForge generated them.
The supplied connection records identify the proxy as the destination, but do not show the external HTTPS destination or the process responsible for the connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records are connection summaries to the explicit proxy; they do not include proxy request details such as the CONNECT target, hostname, or URL.
The supplied records do not attribute these connections to a process on WS-LMARTINS-01.
claims_not_established: Whether the connections were made by the approved PixelForge updater or another process.
Whether the connections reached updates.pixelforge-suite.com or another destination.
Whether the remote destination, TLS certificate, or transferred content was benign.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-NWD-01 access logs for the connection times, including CONNECT targets or other destination host and request details.
Endpoint network telemetry or process logs that associate the connections with an executable and user.
PixelForge updater execution and update-check logs for WS-LMARTINS-01 during the alert window.
unrelated_findings: A separate SMB connection from WS-LMARTINS-01 to DC-NWD-01 was followed by an ANONYMOUS LOGON over NTLM. Review separately; it does not establish whether the alerted proxy connections were malicious. (T036-00034, T036-00036, T036-00037)
